name: astro-njx-muse
description: Premium womenswear storefront: Astro + Tailwind v4 — ink-navy editorial with a transparent-to-solid masthead over a campaign hero slider, hover mega menu, Shop the Look hotspots, quick-size add on cards, cart and wishlist drawers, and a newsletter popup. Works out of the box with mock data, connects to Shopify Storefront API with two env vars.
author: njbSaab (https://njxui.dev)
